compiled_kernel_resources.interpretation: Static compiler declarations only, not measured occupancy or causal timing attribution. Four variants per kernel: zero-only or small-group replay, with or without warmup-only diagnostic reduction.

decision.decision: Keep both sparse GDN routes isolated. Exact masks and small-product groups pass every original/GB10 boundary checked, but captured q8192 product U=V medians are83.5097/84.7262/85.2952ms for control/empty-group skipping/small-group replay. SeparateU medians are83.0970/85.2511/84.6321ms. Individual samples overlap and vary; no repeatable complete gain is established. Dense generated q8192 is also slower. Reduction of275141450 empty groups and43127242 short groups in the captured extension does not justify integration. Preserve the arithmetic primitive and investigate a different execution design.

implementation: Derive exact nonzero bit masks from original packed BF16 operands. Skip a K16 only when its mask intersection is empty; all nonzero normalized original carries are unchanged and an empty zero sum clears negative zero. The second candidate computes the original integer products for intersections of at most four positions. Remaining groups keep the scalar float alignment and complete original integer fallback. Every K16 and checkpoint remains ordered; W/U ownership, original FP32 recurrence/FMA, BF16 endpoints and state ABI are unchanged. Shared metadata preparation belongs to the candidate clock. Warmup-only counters reduce unique CTA records; they do not participate in work selection.
correctness_scope: All65536 BF16 encodings, all65536 support masks and655360 raw carry groups pass UBSan host checks. Native safety covers48 length/data cases, three variants and both U ownership modes, including signed zero, subnormals, strong decay, sparse intersections and exceptional encodings. Every warmup and timed call checks every W/U, H/Vnew, FP32 final state and output against unchanged original kernels, plus independent CPU integer columns. Original GB10 q7169 files directly qualify all29364224 outputs, equal-sized W/U/Vnew references,113 BF16 checkpoints and524288 FP32 final-state values. The q8192 extension takes7168 original rows followed by the first1024 captured rows; its first29360128 outputs/intermediates and112 checkpoints have the external boundary, and all8192 rows have original-arithmetic comparison. References are loaded only for observation and never choose skipped work. The score-preparation fixture copies the original subgroup score arithmetic and separately checks sampled CPU scores. All source/input/table immutability, redzones and inactive U ownership checks pass. This is operator evidence; no new real-model prompt or token loop runs.
timing_scope: Each complete WU/state/output owner uses bounded1024-token segments with uninterrupted FP32 state. One audited warmup precedes three rotated completed host samples per variant and U alias mode; timed calls omit audit reductions/stores and their unused diagnostic storage remains unchanged. Every candidate mask preparation, zero/small group decision, dense/original fallback and final FMA is inside the clock. Allocation, resets, table/capture loading, score preparation and comparison are outside it. This is a WU/state/output clock, not full GDN preparation or model TTFT. Reports with variant0 have zero diagnostic counters because the unchanged control does not emit them; original group work follows the same declared geometry. Static resources are not measured occupancy or a causal attribution.
